selection_process: Candidates will be shortlisted and selected through a combination of educational qualification marks

Educational Qualification: Up to 65% of total marks converted from qualifying marks (varies by post; technical posts also carry separate weightage for technical qualification) Experience: Maximum 15 to 20 marks depending on the post
calculated at the rate of 2-4 marks per year of relevant government/semi-government experience
subject to a maximum of 5 years Written Test/Interview/Skill Test: Up to 20 marks
including bonus marks of up to 15 marks for candidates who have worked under the National Health Mission

and 10 bonus marks for staff who served during the COVID-19 pandemic for at least 6 months (as per government order dated 03.02.2023) Reserved category candidates must secure at least 20% marks and unreserved category candidates at least 30% marks (or as specified per post) in the written/skill test to be considered eligible The final merit list will be prepared by adding qualification marks
and interview/written/skill test marks In case of a tie in total marks
the candidate with greater age will be given preference
The number of candidates called for the written/skill test/interview stage will depend on the number of advertised posts per category: 10 times the vacancies for 1-10 posts
and 3 times for more than 50 posts.
how_to_apply: This recruitment does not involve online submission. Candidates must apply in person on their designated walk-in interview date, following these steps:
Download and fill the prescribed application form available on the official Dhamtari district website (www.dhamtari.gov.in) or the CMHO office notice board.
Attach a recent self-attested passport-size photograph in the space provided on the form.

Arrange all required certificates in the sequence specified in the notification (receipt, application form, educational qualification, residence certificate, caste certificate, employment registration certificate, experience certificate, and other certificates) and staple them securely.
Attach the original Demand Draft/Banker's Cheque for the application fee, drawn in favour of "District Health Society, Dhamtari".
Report in person at the Office of the CMHO, District Dhamtari, between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM on the walk-in date allotted to your post (see schedule below).
Complete registration; the list of eligible/ineligible candidates will be displayed the same evening by 5:00 PM.
Submit any objection to the eligibility list between 5:00 PM and 5:30 PM on the same day, if applicable.
Report the next day at 10:00 AM for the final eligible candidates list, followed by the interview/written/skill test from 11:00 AM onwards.
Applications sent by speed post, registered post, ordinary post, or any other medium will not be accepted. Applications received after the specified date and time will also not be accepted.
important_instructions: All appointments are purely temporary and contractual, valid up to 31 March 2027, and may be extended based on satisfactory performance review. No travelling allowance (TA) will be paid to candidates for appearing at any stage of the recruitment process. Selected candidates must give a bond on a Rs. 50 stamp paper and submit a No Objection Certificate if applying elsewhere. Selected candidates will be required to reside at their place of posting; the posting location will not be transferable or changeable at a later stage. All information submitted in the application must be true; providing false information will lead to immediate cancellation of candidature or termination of service, even after appointment. Merely applying does not guarantee selection; final appointment depends on verification of original documents and actual availability of vacant posts. This recruitment is subject to the final order/decision to be passed in SLP(C) No. 19668/2022, pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India, New Delhi. A waitlist will also be prepared category-wise and will remain valid for one year from the date of issue or until the next recruitment process, whichever is earlier.

Candidates who have completed their postgraduate degree in life sciences can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and M.Sc Life Sciences Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for more healthcare and research opportunities can also explore the latest Chhattisgarh Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings in nursing and paramedical fields can check Staff Nurse Recruitment Jobs and ANM Recruitment Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those holding a postgraduate degree in psychology or life sciences can also browse more NHM Recruitment Jobs and Government Medical Officer Jobs matching their qualification.

content_sections.heading: NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Office of Chief Medical and Health Officer, District Health Society, Dhamtari, Chhattisgarh has officially released Notification No. NHM/भर्ती/2026-27/3820 dated 11 August 2026 for the recruitment of 38 candidates on a contractual basis under the National Health Mission. The recruitment includes various posts such as 2nd ANM, Medical Officer (AYUSH), MPW, Community Health Officer, Nursing Officer, Staff Nurse, Laboratory Technician, Physiotherapist, Psychologist, Dental Assistant, Radiographer/X-Ray Technician and Secretarial Assistant. The official notification is available on the Dhamtari district website. Download NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Official Website

content_sections.heading: NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The walk-in interview process for all 38 posts will be conducted in seven batches between 31 August 2026 and 18 September 2026. Registration on each interview day begins at 9:00 AM. The exact application start date and last date to apply are not available in the notification, since candidates must appear directly at the venue on their allotted walk-in date rather than applying online in advance. Notification release date: 11 August 2026 Walk-in interview dates: 31 August, 02, 07, 09, 11, 15, and 17 September 2026 (registration), with eligible/final lists and interviews held the following day in each batch

content_sections.heading: NHM Dhamtari Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid through a Demand Draft or Banker's Cheque issued by a nationalised bank, in favour of "District Health Society, Dhamtari" . The original Demand Draft/Banker's Cheque must be attached with the application form; the application will not be accepted without it. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications with separate Demand Drafts for each post.

content_sections.heading: NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted and selected through a combination of educational qualification marks, experience marks, and written test/interview/skill test marks, based on the following weightage: Educational Qualification: Up to 65% of total marks converted from qualifying marks (varies by post; technical posts also carry separate weightage for technical qualification) Experience: Maximum 15 to 20 marks depending on the post, calculated at the rate of 2-4 marks per year of relevant government/semi-government experience, subject to a maximum of 5 years Written Test/Interview/Skill Test: Up to 20 marks, including bonus marks of up to 15 marks for candidates who have worked under the National Health Mission, and 10 bonus marks for staff who served during the COVID-19 pandemic for at least 6 months (as per government order dated 03.02.2023) Reserved category candidates must secure at least 20% marks and unreserved category candidates at least 30% marks (or as specified per post) in the written/skill test to be considered eligible The final merit list will be prepared by adding qualification marks, experience/bonus marks, and interview/written/skill test marks In case of a tie in total marks, the candidate with greater age will be given preference The number of candidates called for the written/skill test/interview stage will depend on the number of advertised posts per category: 10 times the vacancies for 1-10 posts, 5 times for 11-50 posts, and 3 times for more than 50 posts.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NHM Dhamtari Walk-in Interview 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry the following original documents along with self-attested photocopies at the time of registration and interview: Mark sheets of 8th, 10th, and 12th class Mark sheets of all years of graduation and post-graduation Mark sheet/certificate of the relevant educational and technical qualification Registration certificate of the concerned professional council (Nursing Council, Paramedical Council, etc., where applicable) Caste certificate issued by a competent authority (for SC/ST/OBC candidates) Domicile/permanent residence certificate Disability certificate (if claiming reservation under the Divyang category) Experience certificate (if claiming experience marks) Original photo identity proof Live registration certificate from the district Employment Office Original Demand Draft/Banker's Cheque for the application fee

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This recruitment does not involve online submission. Candidates must apply in person on their designated walk-in interview date, following these steps: Download and fill the prescribed application form available on the official Dhamtari district website (www.dhamtari.gov.in) or the CMHO office notice board. Attach a recent self-attested passport-size photograph in the space provided on the form. Arrange all required certificates in the sequence specified in the notification (receipt, application form, educational qualification, residence certificate, caste certificate, employment registration certificate, experience certificate, and other certificates) and staple them securely. Attach the original Demand Draft/Banker's Cheque for the application fee, drawn in favour of "District Health Society, Dhamtari". Report in person at the Office of the CMHO, District Dhamtari, between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM on the walk-in date allotted to your post (see schedule below). Complete registration; the list of eligible/ineligible candidates will be displayed the same evening by 5:00 PM. Submit any objection to the eligibility list between 5:00 PM and 5:30 PM on the same day, if applicable. Report the next day at 10:00 AM for the final eligible candidates list, followed by the interview/written/skill test from 11:00 AM onwards. Applications sent by speed post, registered post, ordinary post, or any other medium will not be accepted. Applications received after the specified date and time will also not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: NHM Dhamtari Walk-in Interview Schedule 2026
content_sections.text: On each registration day, candidate registration is held from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM, the eligible/ineligible list is published by 5:00 PM, and objections can be raised from 5:00 PM to 5:30 PM. The final list is published the next day at 10:00 AM, followed by the interview/written test from 11:00 AM onwards. If the process for any batch cannot be completed on the scheduled day, it will continue on the next working day, which will be notified on the office notice board.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 38 vacancies across 20 different contractual posts under the National Health Mission, Dhamtari district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application process. Candidates must submit their filled application form in person at the walk-in interview venue, the Office of the CMHO, Dhamtari, on their designated date.

faq.question: Q3. What are the walk-in interview dates for NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Registration is held on 31 August, 02, 07, 09, 11, 15, and 17 September 2026, with the interview/test for each batch held on the following day.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01 January 2026, the minimum age is 18 years, and the maximum age is 70 years for medical posts and 64 years for managerial posts.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The fee ranges from Rs. 100/- to Rs. 400/-, depending on the candidate's category and the post's salary, payable by Demand Draft/Banker's Cheque in favour of "District Health Society, Dhamtari".

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on marks for educational qualification, relevant experience, and a written test/interview/skill test, subject to minimum qualifying marks for the test stage.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the NHM Dhamtari walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need original and self-attested mark sheets from 8th class onward, relevant qualification certificates, council registration, caste certificate, domicile certificate, experience certificate (if any), and a valid photo ID proof.

faq.question: Q8. What is the contract period for NHM Dhamtari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be engaged on a contractual basis up to 31 March 2027, extendable based on satisfactory performance.
